base_note: Una pagina su come lavoriamo e su cosa potremmo fare per Demak.

evidence.claim: In Demak producete impianti di dosaggio resine e sistemi per potting, incapsulamento e incollaggio di componenti industriali.
evidence.quote: The Demak Group is an Italian manufacturer of resin dispensing equipment and potting resin systems, combining mechanical and chemical expertise under one roof to deliver fully integrated solutions for potting, encapsulation, vacuum casting, gasketing, and bonding of industrial components.
